تنتشقي (form VIII)
# تَنْتَشِقِي (tantašiqī) /tan.ta.ʃi.qiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَشَقَ (intašaqa)
# تُنْتَشَقِي (tuntašaqī) /tun.ta.ʃa.qiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَشَقَ (intašaqa)
